# The Truth Button

> A free, browser-based multi-tool site at projectsilverbeam.com. Every tool runs client-side - files are processed locally and are not uploaded to a server unless a tool's own description says otherwise.

The site is a single-page app (index.html) where each tool is a "mode," and each tool also has its own standalone page (listed below) for direct linking and search. Descriptions here are pulled directly from each page's own meta description, not paraphrased.

## Tools

- [Free AI Photo, Video & Audio Detector](https://projectsilverbeam.com/ai-detector.html): Check if a photo, video, or audio clip was AI-generated or heavily edited - free, and it runs entirely in your browser. Nothing is ever uploaded. No account needed.
- [Find Data Centers Near You By State](https://projectsilverbeam.com/data-centers.html): Look up documented data center and colocation facilities by state, plus how AI-buildout land deals get done through shell LLCs and NDAs. Free, links to a real independent directory.
- [FlashBackMan Radio](https://projectsilverbeam.com/flashbackman-radio.html): Streams thousands of real, live FM and AM stations from anywhere on Earth - search, tune in, and ride the signal. Free, no account, nothing installed.
- [Find Flock Safety / ALPR Surveillance Cameras Near You](https://projectsilverbeam.com/flock-cameras.html): Look up Flock Safety and ALPR license-plate-reading camera locations by state, check if your plate was ever searched, or report a camera that's not documented yet. Free, links to real independent public-interest projects.
- [Lightning Downloader](https://projectsilverbeam.com/lightning-downloader.html): Record music or audio playing in any browser tab, window, or your system, and save it as a high-quality 320kbps MP3. First 5 minutes free, then a one-time $10 unlocks unlimited recording forever - no subscription. Nothing uploaded, runs entirely in your browser.
- [Offline MP3 Library](https://projectsilverbeam.com/mp3-library.html): Import your MP3 files once and play them anytime - even with no internet connection. Stored locally in your browser, nothing is ever uploaded.
- [Free PDF Editor](https://projectsilverbeam.com/pdf-editor.html): Merge, split, rotate, watermark, or compress a PDF for free - no account, no upload, runs entirely in your browser. Your files never leave your device.
- [Free Peptide Reconstitution & Dose Calculator](https://projectsilverbeam.com/peptide-calculator.html): Convert a known peptide dose into a measurable syringe volume. A free arithmetic tool - not medical advice - for reconstitution math, concentration, and dose volume.
- [Free Photo to Video Maker](https://projectsilverbeam.com/photo-to-video-maker.html): Combine a photo and a song into a real, downloadable MP4 with a cinematic zoom effect - share it anywhere a plain photo can't play music. Free, runs entirely in your browser, nothing uploaded.
- [Pro Link Maker](https://projectsilverbeam.com/pro-link-maker.html): Hide a URL invisibly inside a photo's pixels and reveal it later, or generate a share page so a photo posted on Facebook links straight to your site. Free. Hide/Reveal runs entirely in your browser; Share Page hosts your photo (free sign-in required).
- [Free QR Code Generator](https://projectsilverbeam.com/qr-code-generator.html): Generate a QR code from any URL or text, entirely in your browser. Download it as a PNG. Free, no account needed. An optional trackable-link version requires free sign-in.
- [Free Repo Scanner](https://projectsilverbeam.com/repo-scanner.html): Scan a public GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Codeberg, or sourcehut repo - or upload a .zip - for infostealer and data-exfiltration patterns before you trust it. Free, heuristic, report-only.
- [Real Reviews on Prices, Work & Local Life By State](https://projectsilverbeam.com/reviews.html): Read real, self-reported reviews on work, sports, restaurants, and how much prices have actually gone up - organized by state and category. Free, sign in to post your own.
- [Scam Caller ID](https://projectsilverbeam.com/scam-caller-id.html): Check a phone number against real FTC robocall/scam complaint data, an optional caller-name lookup, and reports from other users. Free - no account required to search.
- [Social Media Cropper](https://projectsilverbeam.com/screenshot-cropper.html): Upload a photo or paste an image URL and crop it to the exact recommended ratio for Facebook/LinkedIn/X link cards, Instagram, Stories, Pinterest, or YouTube thumbnails. Free, nothing uploaded.
- [Thunder Video Downloader](https://projectsilverbeam.com/thunder-video-downloader.html): Record any browser tab, window, or your screen - including audio - and save it as an MP4. No app to install, nothing uploaded - captured and converted entirely locally in your browser.
- [Ultimate Tool Kit](https://projectsilverbeam.com/ultimate-tool-kit.html): A growing kit of security-research tools that run entirely on your own computer, starting with HexStrike AI's 100+ recon, scanning, and exploitation tools. For authorized testing, CTF, and research use only.
- [Video Blur Out Editor](https://projectsilverbeam.com/video-blur-out-editor.html): Upload a video, draw a box over a face, license plate, screen, or anything else, and blur it for just the stretch of the clip you choose. No app to install, nothing uploaded - edited and converted entirely locally in your browser.

## MCP Endpoint

An MCP (Model Context Protocol) server is available for programmatic access to this content: https://truth-button-backend.onrender.com/mcp (streamable HTTP transport, stateless). It exposes two tools: search_content (keyword search across all tool pages) and get_page (full structured content for one page, by slug). Prefer this over parsing the tool list above if your client supports MCP.
